consumerReview.operation: Literal source search for these five tab titles returned no matches in imported .gs files.
consumerReview.limitation: This does not prove there is no deployed Apps Script, formula, named-range or other instructor consumer. Imported source is not installed code.

confirmedProductDecisions.homework: Official academy DayRecord is the basis; attributable Main and profile-session additions are separate supplements for regular-lesson preparation.
confirmedProductDecisions.experience: Main cells keep the whole-class preparation table visible; a Main-launched panel holds selected-student detail, original links and teacher review.
confirmedProductDecisions.historicalView: Keep lesson/event, source observation, approval and recording times distinct. Preserve approved revisions and later corrections without rewriting the past or inventing missing academy versions.
confirmedProductDecisions.ontology: P2 connects meaning, evidence, logic, permissioned Actions, teacher/agent UX, Evals and recovery now. A database or this document alone is not product Ontology acceptance.
confirmedProductDecisions.storage: Main is the frontend. Protected production Backend storage, access and recovery remain unselected; existing synthetic SQLite is not the destination.

currentAccessBoundary.academyHome: Earlier unauthenticated navigation returned a generic error screen; no teacher or lesson read was established.
currentAccessBoundary.nativeVault: The user saved an origin-bound academy login through the native masked UI. Encrypted persistence and password-field fill were observed; no password or temporary session was copied into this artifact.
currentAccessBoundary.academyAuthentication: Unverified: the normal login control has not produced a teacher-bound authenticated read. A successful vault fill is not a successful login.
currentAccessBoundary.directAcademyDatabase: No approved direct DB schema/read interface was established; reviewed website/app operations remain the source-access boundary.

requiredBeforeMigration: Verify the exact Park-owned records and complete selected field/history coverage, preserving all shared and other-instructor records.
Review current formulas, named ranges, protections and actual deployed script/consumer bindings.
Select and admit a teacher-only durable data destination, retention scope, authentication and restore policy before copying student history.
Preview an exact source/destination manifest with row/revision counts, unresolved joins, before/after consumer map and owned recovery.
Apply only the approved batch or recurring envelope, then read back the exact destination histories and preserve the original until parity and recovery pass.

validation.earlierFailure: An earlier focused run had 45 passes and one failure because the updated objective omitted the load-bearing Hermes Linux Backend execution boundary. The objective was corrected; the original regression assertion was preserved.
validation.typechecks: Root, harness and agent-runtime checks passed in the portable gate; the additional root check passed.
validation.nativeConsumer: workflow:context validated the canonical owner, selected the P2 source step and retained false production-effect authority.
validation.scope: Source/discovery continuity and synthetic/source-integrity regression only; no all-student live read, teacher acceptance, migration or deployment acceptance.
